description: Transform how you interact with your data. Speak2DB allows you to query your databases using natural language, making data analysis accessible to everyone.
f1-desc: Forget complex SQL. Simply ask your database questions in plain English (or Spanish!), and Speak2DB will retrieve the answers.
f2-desc: Ask for sales projections, check your inventory, or analyze HR performance. Save your favorite queries to generate weekly reports in seconds.
f3-desc: Connect effortlessly to popular databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and even your Excel files.
f4-desc: Understand *how* the AI got your answer. We show you the technical query and explain it in plain language. Need to validate it? Copy it and send it to your IT team.
f5-desc: Not a single number or letter of your data is shared with the AI, only its structure. Any attempt to modify or delete your data is strictly blocked.
f6-desc: Don't just get the answer. Easily export your results and analysis to the formats you already use, like Excel, CSV, or JSON, with a single click.
beta-desc: We're excited to invite you to try the first version of Speak2DB! This is an opportunity to experience the power of querying your databases using natural language before the official launch.
beta-li1-text: The beta will be active for 10 days from first use.
beta-li2-text: This beta version is exclusively for Windows.
beta-li3-text: Initial support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Excel files.
beta-li4-text: Help us improve by reporting any bugs or suggesting new features.
beta-li5-text: This beta version is completely free with no limits on data sources, number of alerts, or AI usage within reasonable use.
